items.question: Who won the biggest El Gordo lottery?
items.answer: Multiple people can buy the winning ticket because the same number gets sold many times. Due to this system, there’s no single winner that can be identified.

items.question: On what channel is the lottery shown?
items.answer: Results of the El Gordo lottery are announced on several different channels. You can watch or listen to the draw on Televisión Española, Radio Nacional de España, and other media outlets.

items.question: How do you win?
items.answer: All you have to do is buy from any officially licensed outlet that sells the tickets. Some people enter El Gordo by using a lottery app or website. Due to the high number of participants, the odds are currently 1:100,000.

items.question: How do you play the El Gordo lottery?
items.answer:
It's quite simple to enter. You can buy your ticket online or from an authorized shop for €200. Those who can't pay that much, there's an option to get a one-tenth stub for €20, but that means you'll only get a tenth of the prize. 

 

All that's left to do is wait for the draw and see if your number wins. There are many prizes, so even if you don't get the grand prize, you might still receive something.

items.question: When is the draw?
items.answer: The lottery draw for El Gordo happens every year on the 22nd of December.

items.question: When does the mega millions drawing take place?
items.answer: The grand prize drawing takes place during the ceremony. Once the numbers are announced, they're broadcast everywhere immediately.

items.question: How does the second chance lottery work?
items.answer: Due to it being a different kind of lottery, El Gordo doesn't have a second chance draw. Thousands of prizes with different values are given to ticket holders that didn't win the jackpot.

items.question: Is there a voucher for the El Gordo Lottery?
items.answer: There's no voucher, but players can buy a piece of a ticket for a portion of a prize if they win.

items.question: How do I cash in winnings from the El Gordo lottery?
items.answer: If you are playing from another country its best to use the El Gordo lottery ticket scanner to check or confirm your winnings.
